snippet.title: Choo Choo Survivor 2 Beta Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the free beta on Steam now! Drive your train through the zombie apocalypse and defeat the boss in this top down action roguelite. You must aim your primary weapon, gather resources with the help of your drones, rescue survivors and upgrade the might of your train strategically. Unlock new locomotives, weapons and bosses to defeat!

Choo Choo Survivor 2 takes some inspiration from Vampire Survivors and Dome Keeper with respect to horde survival and strategic upgrading, but apart from that Choo Choo Survivor 2 is its own experience with its own gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494210/Choo_Choo_Survivor_2/
